damage_formula: see formulas: dmg = ((((rand(26)+256) * (power*(1+crit)*(128-DEF)>>7) >> 8) * f(S)) >> 18) * scale >> 10, then * mult >> 7; f(S)=((26S-701)S+115618)S>>8; crit only melee, chance 164*STR/65536 (0x0800F910)

player_attacks_doc:
Per-attack simulator records for moves.json (imported by extract_moves.py).

Static values come from ROM tables / code constants (address cited, tag DISASM); measured values come from
re/log2/pl_measurements.json (produced by pl_measure_all.py + pl_measure_compact.py on save states
work/states/log2_pl_*.ss: Lv40 characters on map 12 vs class-53 snakes; tag VERIFIED).

Conventions for every record:
  * coordinates are pixels relative to the player's integer position (entity+0x158>>8, +0x15C>>8); +x right, +y down.
  * rects are [x0, y0, x1, y1]; a hit happens when rect overlaps the target hurtbox (strict <).
  * facings: down, up, left, right (entity+0x10 = 0,1,2,3).
  * frames: frame 0 = the frame the button is pressed (state entered the same frame).
  * 'player_vulnerable': whether enemy attacks can damage the player during the move. The player is only
    protected when its damage multipliers (+0x163/+0x164) are 0 (hurt/revert states) or entity+0x168 == 0
    (special-melee release; checked in the player message handler at 0x08008A5C).

timing.note: hit resolves on the press frame (0x08007DE8); next A accepted after the 16-frame anim (VERIFIED)

knockback_given.note: measured on a free snake (class 53); push direction = away from the player; the push itself is the enemy-side hurt reaction (generic actor state 0x02 @0x03002128, ~31 frames) - see Part C

enemy_attacks.rule: player held 240 frames (mash A: -16 extra frames per press); hit at frame 8 (scale 256) then every 16 f (scale 128); Cell heals by damage dealt
Eggbot death: flash, 40-frame pose, 32x32 burst (team 2) then explode

enemy_attacks_note: Enemies use attack table 0x086db2cc ids 1 (energy 1024), 2 (melee 1024), 3 (energy 1024); damage to the player uses the shared formula 0x0800f910 with S = enemy STR (melee) or POW (energy) and the player END/multipliers. Touching an enemy does NOT hurt the player except: class 94 triceratops (ContactDamage, 48-frame cooldown) and enemies in a Charge/Pounce dash. All other melee damage comes from MeleeStrike (instant hit on the first frame of the strike state; box = own hurt rect extended 3-4 px toward the player) or the Cell drain grab. VERIFIED: snake at 14 px only damaged the player on strike-state entry frames.
